title: Stevenson (brand-new dev doc) — agent synthesizes real placement rules
detail: Learning loop on the original Stevenson self-study: learned format 'auto' + 7 matcher-backed placement rules that moved unplaced content into the correct specs (unplaced 17→13, specs 106→107, every card anchored). Rules are DATA the engine executes — not the format lever alone.

title: Kennesaw — agent synthesizes real placement rules
detail: 9 placement rules synthesized; unplaced content 10→2; specs 35→35; every card anchored.

title: Engine routes unplaced tags + classification + file-type (data-only corrections)
detail: apply_post_pass now also places unplaced job.tags a rule targets, and reclassifies to narrative/evidence/appendix/syllabus/cv/matrix. 12 rule-engine + 56 golden-path unit tests pass; strict no-op with empty/baseline rules.

title: Per-region rules reconciled into ONE anchored review state
detail: On all three documents the primary format + the agent's per-region placement/classification rules reconcile into a single review state with 0 un-anchored items (Compare intact) — the hybrid-handling property.

title: SU opens the training review screen in Parser Train mode
detail: The review surface shows the 'Parser Train mode' banner for a sandbox training run; the run is isolated and never affects real submissions.

title: Notes + screenshot persist against the run
detail: A note (with a screenshot data-URI, tied to a std.spec) is stored on the run and surfaced in the dated review page.

title: Approving a spec activates the SPECIFIC rule for that spec, applied on re-run
detail: approve-spec {std,spec} activates only the proposed rule for that spec (others stay proposed); a re-parse then places that spec's content via the activated rule.

title: Global rule activation gated on a fresh golden pass
detail: A ParserTrainGuard marker (stamped by the passing golden suite) gates global activation; institution rules can't touch the baseline and activate freely.

title: Per-run dated review page
detail: GET /:importId/review-page returns a dated report — format, coverage, findings, synthesized rules, learning trajectory — for every run.

title: MCC golden reproduced with the engine LIVE
detail: MCC (935-page narrative PDF): 20 standards, 77 specs, 73 appendix files, 169 items all anchored — structural golden match. AACC + Kennesaw goldens also reproduced exactly. The engine did not move the baseline.

title: A rule reclassifies content to an appendix FILE
detail: An institution rule classified narrative content as 'appendix' → the engine moved it into the spec's evidenceFiles rail, stamped docSubKind='appendix', 0 un-anchored.

title: Stevenson + Kennesaw + MCC all through the learning loop
detail: Stevenson (7 rules), Kennesaw (9 rules), MCC (0 rules — parsed clean) — each learned its parse settings and produced one fully-anchored review state with no specs lost.

title: Activating a training rule leaves a real submission byte-for-byte unchanged
detail: A reference submission's stored review state was byte-for-byte identical before and after activating a training rule.

title: SU opens the training review; Compare locates every card
detail: The Parser Train banner renders; the anchor gate (0 items un-anchored — Compare's exact resolution mechanism) proves Compare locates all cards with none 'section not located'.
